name: Roasted Rack of Lamb with Dauphinoise Potatoes
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's / Disney Treasure · 1923
whyItWorks: Medium-roasted lamb rib chops and thinly sliced peeled Dauphinoise potatoes baked in cream are tender and low in insoluble roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trim off the outer rosemary/parsley herb crust and extra fat edge, enjoy the tender center lamb meat and peeled Dauphinoise potatoes, and skip the whole Brussels sprouts.
watchOuts: Cream in Dauphinoise potatoes if lactose sensitive
